items.html: And this is the secret of “a man who dies in a tent,” and our sages, of blessed memory, said that the Torah does not endure, etc. And it is ZA, who is called Torah, who does not endure except through Mi, which is Tvuna, who kills her very self — her externality within her, which remains without the inner light, which is her life — and this is for the sake of ZA, to give him Mochin, which are his existence.
